dockerfile:
# Selecting a stable base image that includes bash by default
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Environment variables for non-interactive and timezone setup
ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
ENV TZ=Etc/UTC

# Prevent GPG-related issues during apt update
ARG FAKE_DATE
RUN echo 'Acquire::Check-Valid-Until "false";' > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99ignore-time

# Installing essential system dependencies
RUN apt update && apt install -y \
    wget \
    git \
    openjdk-17-jdk \
    maven \
    locales \
    tzdata \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Setting up system locale
RUN echo "en_US.UTF-8 UTF-8" > /etc/locale.gen && \
    locale-gen && \
    update-locale LANG=en_US.UTF-8
ENV LANG en_US.UTF-8
ENV LANGUAGE en_US.UTF-8
ENV LC_ALL en_US.UTF-8
SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-c"]

# Installing Miniconda for environment management
RUN wget 'https://repo.anaconda.com/miniconda/Miniconda3-latest-Linux-x86_64.sh' -O miniconda.sh && \
    bash miniconda.sh -b -p /opt/miniconda3 && \
    rm miniconda.sh
ENV PATH=/opt/miniconda3/bin:$PATH
RUN conda init bash && conda config --set auto_activate_base false

# Accepting the Conda Terms of Service to avoid errors
RUN conda tos accept --override-channels --channel https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/main && \
    conda tos accept --override-channels --channel https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/r

# Creating and setting up the Python virtual environment
RUN conda create -n testbed python=3.11 -y && \
    echo "source /opt/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate testbed" >> ~/.bashrc

# Set up the working directory
WORKDIR /testbed/

# Cloning the target repository and configuring it
RUN source /opt/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate testbed && \
    git clone https://github.com/undertow-io/undertow.git /testbed && \
    cd /testbed && \
    git checkout 77dc917cea6f40468ea481e1bafa7e15657eb887

# Installing project dependencies using Maven
RUN source /opt/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate testbed && \
    mvn install -DskipTests -Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true

# Exposing the Maven configuration to persist within the environment
RUN echo "source /opt/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate testbed" >> ~/.bashrc

# Preserve Maven and Java environment variables
ENV PATH="/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/bin:$PATH"
ENV JAVA_HOME="/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64"
eval_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -uxo pipefail

# Activate the `testbed` environment within the Docker container
source /opt/miniconda3/bin/activate
conda activate testbed

# Move to the testbed working directory containing the repository
cd /testbed

# Run the Maven-based test suite
mvn clean verify

# Capture the exit code and echo it for evaluation
rc=$?
echo "OMNIGRIL_EXIT_CODE=$rc"
